sloka: अथ सीतामनुज्ञाप्य कृतकौतुकमगLअः ।निश्चक्राम सुमन्त्रेण सह रामो निवेशनात् ॥२-१६-२५॥
transliteration: atha sītāmanujñāpya kṛtakautukamagaLaḥ ।niścakrāma sumantreṇa saha rāmo niveśanāt ॥2-16-25॥

translations.english: Adorned in auspicious ornaments, Rama took leave of Sita and departed from his palace accompanied by Sumantra.
